items.title: New Maranhão Stealer Via Pirated Software Leveraging Cloud-Hosted Platforms to Steal Login Credentials
items.description: Since May 2025, a novel credential stealer dubbed Maranhão Stealer has emerged as a significant threat to users of pirated gaming software. items.description: A 0-Click Linux Kernel KSMBD RCE Exploit From N-Day Vulnerabilities, achieving remote code execution on a two-year-out-of-date Linux 6.1.45 instance running the kernelspace SMB3 daemon, ksmbd. items.title: New Phoenix Rowhammer Attack Variant Bypasses Protection With DDR5 Chips
items.description: A new Rowhammer attack variant named Phoenix can bypass the latest protections in modern DDR5 memory chips, researchers have revealed. items.description: A sophisticated and widespread supply chain attack has struck the NPM ecosystem, compromising the popular @ctrl/tinycolor package, which is downloaded over 2 million times per week.
